description: Synthetic comments written for this project (not YouTube data) for an independent creator's review of a fictional language-learning service (not sponsored). Pre-registered hold-out set for the next consolidation experiment: authored separately from t1-topics-v1, t2-topics-v1 and t3-topics-v1 (different product domain, comments, taxonomy and gold), with the gold written before any provider run on it. Same schema and gold semantics as t1-t3: gold taxonomy, one gold topic disposition per non-spam comment and the sentiment toward its primary topic; overall classification labels are oracle inputs, not a classifier benchmark. Test fixtures only.

taxonomy.name: Lesson design and pacing
taxonomy.definition: How lessons are structured, how varied the exercises are and how quickly new material is introduced.

taxonomy.name: Pronunciation feedback
taxonomy.definition: How the speaking exercises score and correct the learner's pronunciation.

taxonomy.name: Live tutor sessions
taxonomy.definition: Booking and quality of one-to-one lessons with human teachers.

taxonomy.name: Chatbot conversation practice
taxonomy.definition: Practising conversations with the automated chat partner and how realistic and helpful it is.

taxonomy.name: Streaks and motivation
taxonomy.definition: Streaks, points, leagues, badges, goals and reminders meant to keep learners practising.

taxonomy.name: Grammar explanations
taxonomy.definition: Whether and how clearly the service explains grammar rules.

taxonomy.name: Languages and course depth
taxonomy.definition: Which languages are offered and how far each course goes beyond the basics.

taxonomy.name: Progress tracking and placement
taxonomy.definition: Placement tests, level estimates and reports showing what the learner has achieved.

taxonomy.name: Offline use and syncing
taxonomy.definition: Using lessons without a connection and keeping progress in sync across devices.
